chapter_title: Concerning the Three Blows that befell the Enemy b
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:** Evil itself — the self hood opposed to the Divine — has been overcome through three successive states of spiritual combat; and in each of these states , the power of Divine Wisdom infl icts upon it a deeper defeat than the last .

**¶2:** In the first state: evil is drawn forth from conce alment into the open, separated from the obsc urity of the unre gen erate natural mind in which it had l ain hidden. It is overcome in this first combat , seized and rest rained by the Divine Life flowing into the soul — for the Living Soul is the Lord's own life present within the interior man .

**¶3:** In the second state: evil is exposed to Divine Love and is dissolved before it, as fals ity dis integrates in the presence of genuine good . It per ishes — overth rown from all the false appearances by which it had sustained its seem ing existence. It is reduced back to its original impotence , constrained within the boundaries of its own nature , rendered as power less as it was before it ever rose against the light of heaven .

**¶4:** The third and final state is the ultimate separation , when all that belongs to good is divided from all that belongs to evil. The active will toward evil is separated from the understanding of fals ity that had served it . The will toward evil is bound into a single rest rained mass, while the understanding of falsity is cast into spiritual death. Between them an immovable Divine Truth is set , so that they can never again conj oin and propag ate — not through any state or age , to eternity.

**¶5 :** This is how the complete subj ugation of evil is accomplished : it is rest rained within Divine Order by bonds from which there is no escape, because the Divine Power has achieved its binding and it is bound forever . And the Divine Power has achieved its complete separation from all that is good , and it remains set apart to eternity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Darkness itself, the Enemy, has received three bad blows with three wars; and worse dangers from the Light in those three wars.
The first: (The Enemy) was brought out to the middle and separated from his dark earth, whence he had departed. He was vanquished in that first war, caught and [bound] by the Living Soul.

The second blow is the time when he will be dissolved and melted, and he perishes in this great fire. He is destroyed and overthrown, from the images that are all by which he exists. And he will be gathered in [to the] fetter corresponding to his archetype, and be made like he was from the first beginning.

The third blow that will befall the Enemy is the 'rolling back' [at the] end when everything will be separated, and male will be divided [from] female. Now, the male will be bound in the lump, but the female [will be thrown] in to the tomb. For it will be divided [and sealed by a great] stone in their midst, for generation upon generation, for ever and ever.

This is the way that the binding of the Enemy will come about, in a fetter that is burdensome and strong, one from which there is never escape; because [they have achieved] his binding and bound him for ever. And they have achieved his being set apart, and he has been set apart for ever.
